title: Mega Man X2
subtitle: SNES · Original game
intro: Follow the boss order, collect armor, hearts and Sub Tanks, and decide whether to restore Zero before the detour closes.

stages.name: Wire Sponge
stages.tip: Fire charged shots after his spinning vine stops. Jump the thrown chain. When he turns red, dodge the lightning and wait for him to become vulnerable.

items.name: Heart Tank
items.text: From the spawn point, turn left. Wall-jump up the left edge and press into the hidden recess near the ceiling.

items.name: Sub Tank
items.text: At the first floating pillar over spikes, jump back left to the tree wall. Climb it, jump right onto the upper platforms, then continue right across the gap to the tank.

stages.name: Wheel Gator
stages.tip: Stay high on the wall while he is submerged. Avoid the saw blades, then hit him with Strike Chain when he surfaces. Hold Fire to extend the chain.

items.name: Arm Parts
items.when: Return after stage 8 — collect these first
items.text: Early inside the tank, after the first ladders, stop at the ceiling opening before descending again. Climb the right wall. Jump left, then air-dash to the hanging wall and climb into the capsule room.
items.extra: Enables charged special weapons and a double charged Buster shot.

items.name: Heart Tank
items.when: Same return trip, after the Arm Parts
items.text: After the Ride Armor section, climb the ladder. The heart is above the spiked wall on your left. Stand on the raised ledge to the right; charge Speed Burner, dash-jump left, then release Fire in midair. Grab above the spikes and climb immediately.

stages.name: Bubble Crab
stages.tip: Drop a Spin Wheel beside him or onto his head. It breaks his bubble shield. Keep clear of his upward claw attack.

items.name: Heart Tank
items.need: Dash wall-jump; charged Bubble Splash makes it easier
items.when: First visit, or collect with the Sub Tank later
items.text: Where the giant fish opens the floor gate, climb the tall right wall. Dash wall-jump left toward the floating vertical platforms. Climb one, ride it upward, then jump onto the high ledge with the heart.

items.name: Sub Tank
items.when: Return after collecting the Arm Parts
items.text: In the broad underwater area, stand on the flat rocky shelf below the tank. Activate charged Bubble Splash, jump to the surface, then press Jump again as X breaks the surface. Move left onto the tank’s ledge.
items.extra: Fill your tanks here with charged Silk Shot →

stages.name: Flame Stag
stages.tip: Hit with Bubble Splash, jump his low fireball, and stay below the high one. Repeat once his damage invulnerability ends.

items.name: Sub Tank
items.when: First visit — before entering the volcano
items.text: Jump onto the first flying beetle’s back. Let it carry you to the top, then jump left onto the high ledge. Get the tank before letting the beetle smash a wall.

items.name: Heart Tank
items.when: First visit — during the rising lava
items.text: Climb quickly as the lava rises. Look for the heart behind a barrier on the left. Destroy the barrier with Spin Wheel, dash in, take the heart, and immediately climb back out. You keep the pickup if the lava catches you.

stages.name: Morph Moth
stages.tip: Use Speed Burner on both the hanging cocoon and the flying moth. Move away from falling debris; fire when he is within reach.

items.name: Body Parts
items.text: Inside the first magnetic-ceiling room, stop at the small step up toward the next room. Fire Spin Wheel into the floor just left of that step. Keep cutting downward, then follow the shaft to the capsule.
items.extra: Reduces damage and adds Giga Crush, which charges when enemy projectiles hit you.

items.name: Heart Tank
items.text: Before the building entrance, knock aside the shield robot’s shield, then freeze the robot with Crystal Hunter. Stand on the crystal, dash-jump right to the building’s upper wall, and climb to the heart.

stages.name: Magna Centipede
stages.tip: Hit him with Silk Shot to remove his tail. Keep moving when he teleports, and avoid being grabbed.

items.name: Heart Tank
items.need: Arm Parts + Speed Burner for this method
items.when: Return after collecting the Arm Parts
items.text: Avoid the early searchlights so the ceiling turret stays in place beneath the upward passage. From the raised ground to its right, jump left and release charged Speed Burner. Catch the turret’s right side, then climb the shaft.

items.name: Sub Tank
items.need: Leg Parts + Arm Parts + Speed Burner for this method
items.text: After the falling-block section, before the giant sword room, look for a narrow ceiling shaft. From the high ledge to its left, jump right, air-dash, then release charged Speed Burner. Catch the shaft wall and climb.

stages.name: Crystal Snail
stages.tip: Use Magnet Mine to knock him out of his shell. Keep pressure on him and stay away from the shell when he tries to reclaim it.

items.name: Heart Tank
items.need: Ride Armor; Strike Chain is optional
items.text: Bring the first Ride Armor back to the earlier pit and land on its left shelf. From the shelf, dash (slide) left, then jump across the gap. Hold Left and pulse Jump: engage the back thrusters, release, then engage again to stretch the hover. At the end of its reach, keep holding Left and press Up + Jump to eject. Let the robot fall; catch the far wall and wall-jump up to the heart.
items.extra: If you fall just short, fire Strike Chain left after ejecting to catch the wall. Watch the jump at 0:25 ↗

items.name: Head Parts
items.text: After the crystal miniboss and the sliding crystal chase, reach the deep pit. Slide down its left wall instead of jumping across. Enter the side tunnel, destroy the crystal enemies, and walk left to the capsule.
items.extra: Adds the Item Tracer. Select it to scan for hidden passages.

stages.name: Overdrive Ostrich
stages.tip: Use Crystal Hunter to freeze him. Wait for him to thaw, then hit him again. Jump over the ground slicers.

items.name: Heart Tank
items.when: First visit; fallback on a return trip
items.text: Keep the bike through the desert ramps and into the building. Ride across the raised spike bed near the end to collect the heart; turn before the spike wall. If the bike breaks, continue and get the Leg Parts.
items.extra: Fallback: return with Arm Parts and Speed Burner. From the left ledge, air-dash right and release charged Speed Burner across the spikes. Expect to lose a life after collecting it; the heart stays collected.

items.name: Leg Parts
items.when: First visit — after the heart’s spike bed
items.text: Near the end, past the scorpion enemies, climb onto the upper-right ledge before the final door. Cut through the gray blocks with Spin Wheel and enter the capsule.
items.extra: Adds air dash. Jump normally, then press Dash in midair.

warning.label: MISSABLE · PERMANENT FOR THIS RUN
warning.title: Want to restore Zero? Stop after boss 2.
warning.text: After Wheel Gator, recover all three Zero parts before defeating another Maverick. Why stop? More boss clears can make the remaining X-Hunters leave permanently. After taking a part in an uncleared stage, lose your remaining lives and choose Continue at Game Over to return to stage select. You keep Zero parts and permanent upgrades. Do not defeat the stage boss just to leave. On a previously cleared stage, use Pause → Exit instead.

routes.name: Standard
routes.subtitle: No Zero-parts detour
routes.description: Follow the weapon chain, collect the upgrades, then fight Zero near the end.

steps.title: Defeat bosses 1–8
steps.text: Follow the boss flow below; skip the X-Hunter detour.

steps.title: Finish the return trips
steps.text: Collect all 4 armor parts, 8 hearts and 4 Sub Tanks.

steps.title: Enter the fortress
steps.text: Shoryuken is optional. Fight Zero, then Sigma.

routes.name: Completionist
routes.subtitle: Restore Zero + all pickups
routes.description: The same boss order, with a mandatory pause after boss 2 to preserve the Zero route.

steps.title: Intro → Wire Sponge → Wheel Gator
steps.text: Collect Sponge’s heart and Sub Tank along the way.

steps.title: STOP · Recover all 3 Zero parts
steps.text: Find Violen, Serges and Agile. Do not defeat boss 3 yet.

steps.title: Return trips → Shoryuken → fortress
steps.text: Complete the 16 upgrades and bonus capsule. Zero helps you instead of fighting you.

returns.title: Freeze a step to the roof
Only if you missed the bike pickup

detour.title: The Zero-parts detour
detour.intro: After boss 2, check the stage-select map for X-Hunter markers. Agile, Serges and Violen move between uncleared stages; no hunter has a fixed stage. These are Zero’s reconstruction parts, separate from X’s Dr. Light armor upgrades.
steps: Enter a stage with an X-Hunter marker. Use the entrance pictures below to find its side room before the regular Maverick boss. An unoccupied hunter door will not open.
Defeat the X-Hunter and receive the Zero part. A charged X-Buster works if you lack the hunter’s weakness.

Leave without defeating the stage’s Maverick: lose your remaining lives, then choose Continue at Game Over to return to stage select. Collected Zero parts and permanent upgrades remain yours. Exit is available only in previously cleared stages.
Check the map again and repeat for the remaining hunters. To change their assignments, enter a previously cleared stage and use Pause → Exit.
Once you have all three parts, resume the boss route at Bubble Crab.

doors.text: At the large rising elevator, slide down the left wall below the platform. Follow the lower passage right to the door; do not fall into the pit below.

media.credit: Gameplay capture: PrimeraEspada91 · Game imagery © Capcom.
media.alt: Wire Sponge — approach to the X-Hunter entrance

doors.text: After the heart’s spike wall and the ceiling bird generators, ride the second upward platform past the normal exit on the left. Keep riding through the spike-lined shaft, then jump off at the top-right ledge before the spiked ceiling. The hunter door is on the right.

media.credit: Gameplay capture: PrimeraEspada91 · Game imagery © Capcom.
media.alt: Wheel Gator — approach to the X-Hunter entrance

doors.text: Cross the underwater area to the far-right wall where the giant fish finishes its route. Climb above the normal entrance into the base to reach the hunter door. Destroy the fish if it obstructs your approach.

media.credit: Gameplay capture: PrimeraEspada91 · Game imagery © Capcom.
media.alt: Bubble Crab — approach to the X-Hunter entrance

doors.text: After escaping the rising lava, cross the sinking pillars to the second beetle. Lure it into the upper breakable wall, then climb through that opening to the hunter door. Do this before destroying the beetle.

media.credit: Gameplay capture: PrimeraEspada91 · Game imagery © Capcom.
media.alt: Flame Stag — approach to the X-Hunter entrance

doors.text: After the first Old Robot miniboss, descend the long ladder. The hunter passage is on the right, behind a shield robot. Defeat it and dash-jump from the wall below its ledge, or air-dash from the opposite wall if you already have Leg Parts.

media.credit: Gameplay capture: PrimeraEspada91 · Game imagery © Capcom.
media.alt: Morph Moth — approach to the X-Hunter entrance

doors.text: After the sword miniboss, dash right through the room with falling blocks. The hunter door is at the lower-right end, beside a large health pickup. Reach it before a block seals the entrance; if blocked, retry the stage.

media.credit: Gameplay capture: PrimeraEspada91 · Game imagery © Capcom.
media.alt: Magna Centipede — approach to the X-Hunter entrance

doors.text: Keep the Ride Armor. At the crystal-blocked spike pit, get out and move right to trigger the giant sliding crystal, then return for the armor. Ride across to the right ledge, jump back onto the upper-left ledge above the ladder and punch through its crystal blocks. Jump out onto the small flying platforms and ride them up to the door.

media.credit: Gameplay capture: PrimeraEspada91 · Game imagery © Capcom.
media.alt: Crystal Snail — approach to the X-Hunter entrance

doors.text: Near the start, stop at the first downward ladder. Fire Spin Wheel into the sand wall on its right to open a horizontal tunnel. Walk through to the hunter door.

media.credit: Gameplay capture: PrimeraEspada91 · Game imagery © Capcom.
media.alt: Overdrive Ostrich — approach to the X-Hunter entrance

detour.recoveryNote: Ordinary return trips cannot recover a part after its X-Hunter has left. Continue on the standard path, or restore an earlier save/password to preserve the completionist route.

exitWarning.title: Why Game Over?
exitWarning.text: Exit is locked while that stage’s Maverick is alive. Beating the Maverick just to get out advances the boss count and can make remaining X-Hunters leave for good. Game Over → Continue returns you to the map without that risk; Zero parts and permanent upgrades stay collected.

extraSections:
Useful tips

Refills and preparation

Fast Sub Tank refill · Bubble Crab

Need: Arm Parts + Silk Shot (Morph Moth). Return after getting the Arm Parts; this is unavailable during the early Zero detour on this route.

  1. Enter Deep-Sea Base. Where the giant fish opens the horizontal floor gate, slide down the left wall into the hidden side room.
  2. Select Silk Shot and hold Fire to fully charge it. The charge draws large health capsules into the room. Collect them, then charge again as needed.
  3. Restore X to full health first; further health pickups fill your collected Sub Tanks. Repeat until the tanks are full, then use Pause → Exit on this cleared stage.

This is the room’s built-in weapon interaction. It refills tanks you already own; it does not award new tanks.

Emergency refills · enemy dispensers

At a bird-dispensing machine, keep the dispenser intact and shoot the birds with the Buster. Collect their drops between waves. Health fills Sub Tanks once X is healthy; select the weapon you want to refill before collecting weapon energy.

Bonus: Shoryuken

X-Hunter stage 3

Bring: all 4 armor parts, all 8 hearts, all 4 Sub Tanks, and full health when entering the hidden capsule room. Zero’s parts are not required. Bring filled tanks to heal after the spike section.

  1. After the vertical elevator section, take the upper ladder. Freeze a bat with Crystal Hunter and use it as a step.
  2. Cross the upper spike route with air dashes and charged Speed Burner. At the final curved spike passage, move right, drop, then dash back left toward the 1-Up.
  3. At the following downward shaft, slide against the left wall. Refill health before entering the hidden passage. Walk left to the capsule.

To use it: at full health, stand on the ground with the X-Buster selected. Press forward → down → down-forward + Fire. Mirror the directions when facing left.

Unlock requirements ↗ · Spike route and input ↗

Fortress boss order

Finish the run
StageFightUse / do
1Neo ViolenBubble Splash. Use the blocks as cover from his mace.
2Serges TankGiga Crush clears the four cannons if charged; otherwise use the Buster. Then use charged Sonic Slicer on Serges.
3Agile FlyerMagnet Mine. Collect Shoryuken before this boss if you want it.
4Eight Maverick rematchesAny order. Reuse the boss flow; Sonic Slicer for Wire Sponge.
5Zero, if parts are missingSpeed Burner or charged Buster. Shoot between his attacks.
5Neo Sigma → Sigma VirusSonic Slicer for the clawed form; Strike Chain for the wireframe head. Destroy spawned enemies for health and weapon energy.

routeIntro: Both paths can collect every armor part, heart and Sub Tank. The difference is the Zero detour and the final encounter.
flowIntro: Read from 01 to 08. Each reward is the next boss’s weakness. Start Wire Sponge with the X-Buster; use Sonic Slicer in his rematch.
basicsHtml:
Before you start: movement, charging and saving
  • Ground dash is available from the start. Leg Parts add air dash: jump normally, then press Dash.
  • Charged special weapons require Arm Parts. Hold Fire with that weapon selected, then release.
  • “Need” describes the method shown; advanced tricks can bypass some requirements.
  • Permanent pickups survive death. On completed stages, use Exit from the pause menu. Record your password before ending a session.
  • Fill Sub Tanks by collecting health at full life; use them from the pause menu. Fast refill: Bubble Crab + charged Silk Shot.

startHereHtml:
First time playing X2?

What to know before the route

X keeps his ground dash from the first game. The new armor adds air movement, charged weapons and a Giga Crush attack. Collect hearts and fill Sub Tanks as you follow the boss order.

Restoring Zero is a separate, optional objective. It changes a late encounter, but is not needed to finish the game. If you want all three Zero parts, stop after Wheel Gator and take the detour before defeating another Maverick.

Legs
Add a horizontal air dash. Jump normally before pressing Dash.
Arms
Allow charged special weapons and a second charged Buster shot. Several return pickups need them.
Body
Reduce damage and add Giga Crush, which builds energy when X takes projectile hits.
Head
Add a scanner for hidden passages and objects.

Sub Tanks hold reserve health. Bubble Crab’s hidden refill room provides health with charged Silk Shot once you have the Arm Parts.

Heart Tanks increase maximum health. Fill Sub Tanks by collecting health while your life bar is full, then use them from the pause menu.
